_readme: Content for the /services catalogue and the SPOT·AI chat assistant. The chat reads this file live; the catalogue pages in services.html were generated from it.
intro: A technology-enabled agency service framework that connects planning, content, publishing, paid amplification and performance learning.
humanLed: AI supports research, repetitive operations and first drafts. Spotlight people lead strategy, creativity, judgment, approvals and client relationships.

pillars.name: Strategy & Intelligence
pillars.desc: Digital strategy, audience intelligence, competitor intelligence, platform strategy, campaign planning and content strategy.

pillars.name: Content & Creative
pillars.desc: Content calendars, copywriting, static social creatives, carousels, Reels, Shorts, campaign adaptations and multi-format production.

pillars.name: Social Media Management
pillars.desc: Account management, scheduling, publishing, approvals, community monitoring and ongoing channel optimisation.

pillars.name: Paid Media & Performance
pillars.desc: Meta Ads, Google Ads, campaign setup, audience targeting, creative testing, budget pacing, optimisation and performance analysis.

pillars.name: Social Listening & Digital Intelligence
pillars.desc: Brand mentions, sentiment, trends, conversation spikes, competitor activity and emerging opportunities or issues.

pillars.name: Analytics, Reporting & Optimisation
pillars.desc: Live or periodic performance dashboards, automated reports, campaign insights, content-performance analysis and recommendations for the next cycle.

steps.title: Start with a clear client brief
steps.text: You share your brand, objective, audience, campaign brief and budget. Spotlight turns these inputs into a coordinated strategy and content calendar.

steps.title: Create, approve and activate
steps.text: We develop copy and creative, get human approval, schedule and publish, and run paid amplification. AI-written copy stays a draft until reviewed, and budget changes start as recommendations that need human approval.

steps.title: Measure, learn and improve
steps.text: We monitor audience response and campaign performance, find the themes, formats, hooks and channels that work, and feed those learnings into next month's strategy: a closed learning loop across content and paid media.

positioning: The six pillars work as one end-to-end digital growth service. Every engagement connects your objective, strategy, execution and performance review, so each deliverable has a clear purpose within the campaign.
